name: font-tastic-monorepo
description: Open-source in-app typography devtool with auto-detection for web projects

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @font-tastic/core build && pnpm --filter @font-tastic/devtool build && pnpm --filter font-tastic-web build
scripts.release: pnpm --filter "@font-tastic/*" build && (cd packages/core && npm publish --access public) && (cd packages/devtool && npm publish --access public)
